# Claude Code 2.1.332 fixtures

A recording of the real Claude Code 2.1.332 (full-screen renderer) in a 120 × 40 terminal, run against a scratch
folder with a fake account. Tests of the transcript parser and of the dialog reader read these files.

Generated by `node scripts/claude-capture-fixtures.mjs <recording out dir> <this folder>`; never edit by hand. The
script rewrites every identifying path, home folder, account folder and e-mail address at the same length, so each
screen row keeps its width and a path Claude Code wrapped across two rows is still wrapped at the same column.
The project folder becomes `/work/hello/nested/…/project`, a home folder `/home/uuu…`, an account folder
`.claude-xxx`. `tests/integration/claude-capture-fixtures.test.ts` checks every file here.

## `transcript.jsonl`

The session's transcript, 119 lines, already filtered to `user`, `assistant`, `system`, `queue-operation`,
`permission-mode`, `agent-name` and the `queued_command` / `plan_mode` attachments.

## Sessions recorded on their own

Three more sessions of the same Claude Code 2.1.332, each in a scratch folder of its own (Haiku 5.5, one-line
prompts), filtered the same way:

| File | Shows |
|---|---|
| `rewind.jsonl` | three prompts; a rewind (Esc Esc, the second prompt, Restore conversation) and a new prompt whose `parentUuid` is line 4, the first turn's end, as the prompt it replaces had; then a rewind to the first prompt and a new prompt with `parentUuid: null`, as the first prompt had |
| `commands.jsonl` | bash mode (`! ls`), `/cost` (it writes nothing), Esc while a reply streams, `/compact`, then `/exit` and `claude --continue`, which appends to the same file; each followed by a prompt whose parent is the line before it in the whole transcript (here, at times, a line filtered out) |
| `esc-before-reply.jsonl` | a prompt taken back by Esc before any reply (it stays in the file), then another prompt whose `parentUuid` is the same line 4: a branch, as a rewind writes |

## `screens/`

Each screen comes as `<name>.txt` (the 40 rows as text) and `<name>.ans` (the terminal snapshot with its colours and
dim text).

| Screen | Shows |
|---|---|
| `trust` | the folder trust dialog at startup |
| `bash`, `bash-second` | a Bash permission dialog (`touch made-by-bash.txt`, then `touch second.txt` with the cursor on Yes) |
| `bash-on-no`, `bash-amend`, `bash-amend-typed`, `bash-after` | the second request with the cursor on No, then on the feedback field, typed, and sent |
| `edit` | an Edit permission dialog |
| `plan` | the plan approval dialog; `plan-field` and `plan-field-typed` its feedback field empty and typed; `plan-after` the plan accepted |
| `question`, `question-fruit` | a question with options, and one with a free-text option |
| `question-field`, `question-field-typed` | the free-text field empty and typed |
| `questions-first`, `questions-second`, `questions-review` | a two-question form: each page, then the review page |
| `several`, `several-submit`, `several-review` | a multi-select question, the cursor on Submit, the review page |
| `model-typed`, `model` | `/model` typed, then its menu |
| `working-typed`, `queued`, `idle` | text typed while Claude works, a queued prompt, Claude done |
| `working` | Claude working, before an interrupt |
| `paste-three-lines`, `paste-three-lines-typed` | a bracketed paste of 3 lines drawn as typed in the prompt, then a key typed after it |
| `paste-line-500`, `paste-line-800` | a paste of one line of 500 and of 800 characters, drawn as typed (wrapped at spaces) |
| `paste-line-801`, `paste-line-1000`, `paste-line-2000` | one line of more than 800 characters, folded into `[Pasted text #1]` |
| `paste-four-lines`, `paste-forty-lines`, `paste-forty-lines-typed` | more than 2 line breaks, folded into `[Pasted text #1 +3 lines]`, `+39 lines`, then a key typed after it |
| `paste-two-long-lines`, `paste-three-long-lines` | more than 800 characters over 2 and 3 lines: `+1 lines`, `+2 lines` |
| `image-pasted`, `image-text` | a PNG's path pasted alone into an empty prompt, drawn as `[Image #1]` (not dim); then ` What color is this image?` pasted after it, drawn right after the marker |

The `paste-*` screens come from Claude Code started anew in a folder of its own for each paste, never sent (so no
transcript): they show its start banner. The paste is one write, `ESC[200~`, the text with its newlines as CR,
`ESC[201~`, as Atelier types a prompt.

The `image-*` screens come from Claude Code started the same way, in a folder of its own, with none of its user
settings but the full-screen renderer (`--setting-sources project --settings '{"tui":"fullscreen"}'`), and added with
`node scripts/claude-capture-fixtures.mjs <recording out dir> <this folder> image-pasted image-text`. The image's
path is one bracketed paste on its own, the text a second one; nothing is sent.
